source.source_scope_note: This integration preserves every final race profile present in the attached concordance: 34 Universal homeworld peoples and 26 preserved Alien-Folk profiles.

play_rules.choose_one_race: Choose one race profile at character creation. Select a listed bloodline or form only when the race provides one.
play_rules.no_fixed_ability_scores: Race never grants a fixed ability-score increase, alignment, class, personality, or compulsory religion.
play_rules.physiology_and_permissions: Body, abilities, and limitations establish anatomy and fictional permissions. Use normal tests when an outcome is uncertain; a race entry does not silently add numerical bonuses unless a future option explicitly says so.
play_rules.limitations_are_not_point_flaws: Listed limitations are real fictional constraints and safety-relevant setting facts. They do not award Background Build Points or XP.
play_rules.culture_is_separate: The society text is a common cultural pattern, not mandatory behavior. Community, upbringing, language, and personal history remain separate character choices.
play_rules.deity_associations: Homeworld deity links are public religious and cultural associations. They are not biological ownership, compulsory worship, or proof that one Architect solely created a race.
play_rules.alien_deity_scope: The attached assignment index intentionally does not assign the off-world Alien-Folk to Universalian deities.
